title: Campfire Coleus - 1x Mini Plug Plant - Vibrant Orange Foliage
description:
Bring a fiery glow to your garden with Campfire Coleus!
KEY FEATURES
• Vibrant orange-red and copper foliage
• Maintains colour intensity in both sun and shade
• Compact, mounded growth habit
• Late flowering for prolonged foliage display
• Ideal for containers, beds, and borders
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Solenostemon scutellarioides 'Campfire'
Colour: Orange-red and copper foliage
Season: Summer (foliage)
Growth Habit: Upright, Bushy
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun, Partial shade
Soil: Chalk, Clay, Loam, Sand
Watering: Heavy, Moist but well-drained
Spacing: 24 in. (61 cm)
Height: 14 - 28 in. (36 - 71 cm)
Spread: 14 - 24 in. (36 - 61 cm)
Hardiness: H1C (can be grown outside in summer (5-10°C)) / USDA 9b
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in humus-rich, moist but well-drained soil.
• Pinch out tips to encourage bushiness and a denser habit.
• Fertilise once a month during the growing season (175-225 ppm N).
• Keep well-watered, avoiding standing water.
• Protect from frost; can be brought indoors for winter in colder climates.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
1x Mini Plug Plant
